verses.text: Di elder to di beloved Gaius, wey I love in truth.
Beloved, I pray say you go prosper for everything and dey healthy, even as your soul dey prosper.
For I dey very happy when brothers come and bear witness to your truth, even as you dey walk in truth.
I no get greater joy than dis: to hear say my pikin dem dey walk in truth.
Beloved, you dey act faithfully for anything wey you do for di brothers and for strangers;
dem don bear witness of your love before di church. You go do well if you send dem go for dem journey in a way wey worthy of God;
because for di sake of im name, dem go out, and dem no dey take anything from di Gentiles.
We suppose support such people, so that we go be fellow workers for di truth.
I write something to di church, but Diotrephes, wey love to dey first among dem, no dey receive us.

So if I come, I go remind am of di works wey e dey do, as e dey talk wicked words against us. E no even stop for dat one, e no dey receive di brothers, and e dey stop those wey wan receive dem and dey throw dem out of di church.
Beloved, no copy wetin bad, but wetin good. Anybody wey do good na from God; anybody wey do bad never see God.
Everybody dey give Demetrius good witness, and di truth itself too. Yes, we also bear witness, and you know say our witness true.
I get plenty things to write, but I no wan write to you with ink and pen;
but I hope say soon I go see you, and we go talk face to face. Peace to you. Di friends dey greet you. Greet di friends by name.
